periods.time: Shopping interlude before the evening third round
periods.label: 艾莉丝替莎拉打磨原石

status.current: helps Sara dress and later accompanies Shizuku for pre-match preparations
status.condition: absent from stands when Shizuku's match is called

personality.summary: Stylish, teasing and perceptive, able to judge moral rot by hard-earned instincts.
core_traits: empathetic toward those forced into darkness

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Close friend; Ikki asks him to style Sara before the match.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Closest companion; he sits with her, follows her for final preparations, and is expected to support her against Amane.
relationships.sara-bloodlily: He styles her, teaches basic makeup and recognizes she lacks the rotten smell of willful evil despite Rebellion ties.
relationships.stella-vermillion: He deliberately provokes Stella's competitive pride so she will try harder rather than rely on being Ikki's girlfriend.

periods.summary: Alice meets Ikki and Shizuku at the dome exit after Ikki asks for help dressing Sara. He uses shadow stealth to avoid the crowd and takes Sara through cosmetics and clothing, using his Shadow Spot hideout for privacy. He judges that Sara is not malicious like many Rebellion criminals and listens to her explanation of accepting surgery and support from Rebellion as a transaction. He selects an outfit that works within Sara's extremely weak stamina and reframes her lack of fashion interest as a chance to compete for Ikki's attention, which also provokes Stella into self-reflection. Later he leaves with Shizuku for her pre-match preparation and is not in the stands when her match is supposed to begin.

key_events.summary: Styles Sara and hears about her transactional link to Rebellion.
Is notably absent from the stands when Shizuku and Amane fail to enter.
